title: Human Heart

facts: Atomic number 6: 6 protons, 6 neutrons (the most common isotope, C-12)
Drawn as the Bohr model: electrons really sit in clouds of probability, not on rings.

info.Oxygen: Oxygen atoms (red): each forms two bonds in total and keeps two lone pairs of electrons.
info.Bonds: Shared pairs of electrons holding the atoms together; two sticks show a double bond, three a triple bond.
